Who We Are

Designers who build with their hands.

2NOMADS is a transportation design studio based in Pune, founded by R Donshong Koren — automobile designer, clay modeller and educator, and former Head of the Transportation Design Department in Canada.

We work with OEMs on clay models, design correction and full working prototypes, while our Academy trains the next generation of designers in the same studio, on the same real projects.

  • 01OEM clay modelling — scale and full-size
  • 02Show and working prototypes, EV and ICE
  • 03Hands-on design education
  • 04In-house EV projects — Oneaxi Scooter
Academy

Learn from those who build.

Concept to prototype — taught by industry-hardened designers, in a working studio. Evening batches so you never miss college or work.

Academy · 01

Transportation
Design

Learn how a vehicle is born — from research and concept thinking to sketching, proportion and virtual rendering. Work on real briefs the way a professional design studio does.

  • —Research & concept thinking
  • —Sketching & proportion
  • —Digital rendering
  • —Design presentation
Academy · 02

Clay Modelling

The craft at the heart of automotive design. Learn tools, armatures, surfacing and how to read highlights — taught by a clay modeller who has trained students under SIAM and MITID.

  • —Armature & clay build-up
  • —Traditional clay tools
  • —Surface & highlight reading
  • —Scale to full-size models
Digital sculpt screen
Academy · 03

Digital
Sculpting

Sculpt form on screen with the same eye you use in clay. Build, refine and visualise designs digitally, ready for milling, printing or presentation.

  • —Digital form development
  • —Surface refinement
  • —Visualisation
  • —Preparing data for milling & printing
Academy · 04

Scanning

Bridge the physical and digital. Capture clay models and parts in 3D, clean the data and bring it back into the design loop.

  • —3D scanning workflow
  • —Point cloud & mesh cleanup
  • —Clay-to-digital loop
  • —Reverse engineering basics
Academy · 05

Prototype —
Show & Working

See how a design becomes a real object. Learn hard modelling, tooling, FRP and fabrication for show prototypes, and how they evolve into working, running prototypes.

  • —Hard modelling & tooling
  • —FRP & finishing
  • —Show prototype build
  • —Working prototype build

Studio · 01

Clay
Service

Scale and full-size clay models for two-wheelers, cars and concepts. We take your design through clay, correct it surface by surface under proper studio lighting, and hand back a model ready for review or scanning.

  • —Scale & 1:1 clay models
  • —Design correction in clay
  • —Scanning & data handover
  • —Presentation-ready finish
Finished prototype photo
Studio · 02

Prototype
Service

Show prototypes for launches and auto expos, and working prototypes that actually run — from a Jawa 42 build and the Jawa/BSA Bobber for Classic Legend to a three-wheel delivery concept for Pluto Mobility.

  • —Show / display prototypes
  • —Working running prototypes
  • —Metal fabrication & FRP
  • —EV & ICE platforms
